title: Iran protests death toll tops 2,000, activists say, in worst upheaval since 1979 revolution
summary: US-based activists said the death toll in the Iranian government's crackdown on the largest protest movement since the 1979 revolution had passed 2,000. While an enduring internet blackout has made it impossible to know the full scale of the violence, some Iranians have been able to report what they've seen via phone calls.
